head:
You are not broken.
You are lost in a movie.
The next thing you buy won't fix the feeling.
sub: Try a Sacred Pause first. One breath.

head: I was twelve in Kabul when soldiers took boys off the street.
sub: Nobody stopped me. That afternoon, a law got written.

head: Your feed isn't a window. It's a mirror with a business model.
Step out onto a balcony above your own mind.
sub: Down below, the thoughts are still moving. Just watch.

head: She hadn't stopped loving me. She had stopped waiting for me to come back into the room.
sub: The moment I started waking up.

head: If you could not work for a year, who would be left?
When did you last tell somebody the actual truth about how you are?
No robes. No diplomas. Just a car-audio shop and the worst year of my life.
That late-night scroll isn't rest. It's avoidance with a good excuse.
Which of the five movies is yours?

Don't believe me.
Investigate for yourself.
sub: Burned by self-help? Good. Stay skeptical.

head: I still get triggered. What changed is how long I stay lost in it.
sub: Notice the movie. Come back sooner.

head: I don't think you need a new you.
sub: Just the end of being completely fooled.

head: "What am I like when I'm stressed?"
sub: Ask someone you live with. Don't explain. Just say thank you.

head: You are not looking at a defect. You are looking at your best work, still running.
sub: Long after the problem it solved went away.
